items.prompt: Can the white queen on d4 go to h8 in one move? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: The diagonal d4-h8 is empty, so the queen can go to h8.

hints: Which line from d4 leads toward h8: a rank, a file or a diagonal?
Trace the diagonal square by square: e5, f6, g7, h8. Is anything on it?
items.explain: The diagonal from d4 to h8 has nothing on it (e5, f6 and g7 are empty), so the queen slides all the way.

items.prompt: A white pawn now stands on f6. Can the white queen on d4 go to h8 in one move? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: The queen's own pawn on f6 blocks the diagonal.
The queen can still stop on e5, in front of the pawn.

hints: Which line from d4 leads toward h8: a rank, a file or a diagonal?
Trace the diagonal square by square: e5, f6, g7, h8. Is anything on it?
Look at what changed: a white pawn on f6 sits on that diagonal.
items.explain: The pawn on f6 stands on the diagonal. The queen cannot jump over it or land on it, so h8 is out of reach; she can only go as far as e5 on that line.

items.prompt: A black pawn now stands on b3. Can the white queen on d4 go to h8 in one move? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: The diagonal d4-h8 is still empty.

hints: Which line from d4 leads toward h8: a rank, a file or a diagonal?
Trace the diagonal square by square: e5, f6, g7, h8. Is anything on it?
Is the pawn on b3 on the line from d4 to h8?
items.explain: The pawn on b3 is not on the diagonal from d4 to h8, and it blocks no other line toward h8, so nothing changes: the queen can still go to h8. The pawn on b3 is a knight's jump away from d4, but the queen does not move like a knight, so it is no obstacle and no target on the way to h8.

items.prompt: A black pawn appears on h5, far from the knight. Can the white king capture the black knight on d5? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: The king can capture on d5.

hints: Is the knight on a neighbouring square? Yes. So the question is whether d5 is guarded.
Does the pawn on h5 attack d5 or any square near it?
items.explain: The pawn on h5 attacks only g4. No black piece attacks d5, so the king may still take the knight.
